evals.name: nextjs-feed-from-scratch
evals.prompt: In my Next.js 16 App Router app, /feed currently loads all ~2000 posts from Postgres at once in a Server Component and renders them — it's slow and janky. Rows have a title, excerpt, author, and sometimes an image. Turn it into an infinite scroll that feels instant, and when I click into a post and hit back I want to land where I was. We use TanStack Query already.
evals.expected_output: Keyset-paginated GET route, server-rendered first page hydrated into useInfiniteQuery, virtualized list with id keys, prefetch ahead of the edge, a scroll-restoration strategy, a11y feed markup.
assertions: Uses cursor/keyset pagination with a unique tiebreaker (not OFFSET)
Server-renders page one and hydrates it into TanStack Query (HydrationBoundary/dehydrate or initialData)
Later pages come from a GET Route Handler, not a Server Action
Virtualized list keyed by item id (getItemKey or equivalent), not index
Next page is triggered ahead of the last row (threshold/rootMargin), with an isFetchingNextPage guard
Concrete back-navigation scroll restoration mechanism (snapshot+offset, Activity/cacheComponents, or library cache)
Reserves image space (width/height or aspect-ratio) to avoid measurement jumps
Feed a11y: role=feed/aria-busy or equivalent, and focus handling or load-more fallback mentioned

evals.name: chat-prepend-jumps
evals.prompt: our support chat panel (react 19, tanstack query useInfiniteQuery, react-window VariableSizeList) is a mess. when you scroll up and older messages load, the view jumps. and when a new websocket message arrives while you're reading old history it yanks you to the bottom. messages have variable height (markdown, sometimes images). rewrite the ChatPanel component properly.
evals.expected_output: End-anchored virtualizer (TanStack anchorTo:'end' + followOnAppend, or virtua shift) with stable id keys, fetchPreviousPage for history, follow only when pinned, jump-to-latest.
assertions: Replaces react-window v1 VariableSizeList with a library that supports reverse/prepend anchoring (TanStack Virtual anchorTo end, virtua shift, or react-virtuoso)
Uses library anchoring rather than manual scrollTop += delta or column-reverse hacks
Stable message-id keys
Older history loaded via fetchPreviousPage/getPreviousPageParam (or equivalent prepend)
New messages only auto-follow when the user is pinned to the bottom
Provides a jump-to-latest affordance when not pinned
Handles variable heights via dynamic measurement (measureElement or library auto-measure)

evals.name: diagnose-dupes-and-stall
evals.prompt: (see with_skill prompt in workspace) Offset pagination sorted by popularity + one-shot IntersectionObserver; diagnose duplicates and 4k-monitor stall.
evals.expected_output: Duplicates: offset shifting under inserts + non-unique sort (popularity ties) → keyset with id tiebreaker (and/or client dedupe for mutable popularity). Stall: IO fires only on change; sentinel stays visible after page 1 on tall screens → re-observe/re-check after each page. Also index keys → id keys, guard in-flight.
assertions: Identifies OFFSET shifting under concurrent inserts as a cause of duplicates
Identifies non-unique sort (popularity ties) and adds an id tiebreaker
Addresses that popularity is mutable (dedupe by id client-side or snapshot)
Identifies that IntersectionObserver only fires on intersection changes so a still-visible sentinel never refires
Fix re-checks/re-observes after each page load (or loops until viewport filled)
Adds an in-flight/hasMore guard to prevent duplicate or endless requests
Replaces index keys with product id keys
